_comment: HAND-AUTHORED, additive extension to alias-map.json for the 39 FD5-Shopping-List-Morrisons.html rows (tools/extract/morrisons.js, data/raw/morrisons.json rows[].name). Kept in a SEPARATE file (not merged into alias-map.json) so join.js's pre-existing 'alias-map-covers-55-short-names' hard gate — which counts alias-map.json's keys against the canonical 55-row FD5-Shopping-List.html basket — is never disturbed by variant-only additions. 38 of the 39 Morrisons row names are byte-identical to short names already mapped in alias-map.json (tools/extract/join.js's variant-morrisons section looks up alias-map.json first, falling back to this file); only the one row below has different wording from its canonical counterpart. 'Sirloin steak' names the same ingredient as alias-map.json's 'Rump or sirloin steak' (beef_steak) — confirmed against data/ingredients.json's beef_steak.name.canonical, which reads exactly 'Sirloin steak'. ZERO fuzzy matches.
